questions.question: How can I declare a higher value for my checked bag?

Liability is raised to the declared value but will not exceed 2500 EUR (approx. 2010 SDR) per checked bag, and you need proof of value (purchase receipt) if you make a claim. The declaration covers one flight journey in one direction, so return flights need a separate form for each flight. The General Conditions of Carriage give a supplementary-fee route with a limit of 2,224 SDRs (approximately EUR 2,800), which differs from the Help Centre's 2500 EUR limit, so please check the exact limit and fee with Wizz Air.
